content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">THE EDEN BAZAAR IS NOW OPEN!</>
content.text:
The Eden Bazaar is officially open and ready for business!

Built to bring our player-driven economy together in one place, the Bazaar is a dedicated medieval trading city featuring <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">42 shop plots</> for Survivors looking to establish their own stores and become part of our growing marketplace.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">EXPLORE THE BAZAAR</>

Take some time to explore the city, wander through its streets, check out the available plots and discover what other Survivors have to offer.

Found a plot you like? <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Claim it and make it your own!</>

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">HOW TO CLAIM A SHOP</>

Visit <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">https://arkprojecteden.com</> and complete the shop plot application form.

When applying, make sure to include the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">street address of the shop plot</> you'd like to claim.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">BAZAAR LOCATION</>

The Eden Bazaar is located on <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">The Island</> at <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Herbivore Island</>.

Coordinates:
<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">88.2 / 89.7</>

Come take a look, find your spot and become part of the Eden marketplace!

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">GEN 1 ASCENSION RACE</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">THE ASCENSION RACE</>

The race is on! The <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">first tribe to ascend on Alpha difficulty</> will receive the following rewards:

• A <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">personal Gas Vein</> at their base
• A <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">personal Oil Vein</> at their base
• A <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">personal Water Vein</> at their base
• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">10,000 Eden Tokens</>

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">SOLO SURVIVORS</>

The <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">first solo player</> to ascend will receive the same rewards.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Good luck, Survivors! May the fastest tribe win.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">GENESIS 1 — BUILDING RULES</>
content.text:
Genesis 1 has limited land across its smaller biomes, so we have a few additional building rules to make sure everyone has a fair opportunity to establish an outpost.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">MAIN BASES & OUTPOSTS</>

• All tribes must place their <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">main base in the Ocean biome</>.
• The other biomes are reserved for your <RichColor Color="0.6078,0.5137,1">single 4x4 outpost</>.
• This allows more players to establish viable outposts across the limited land biomes.
• Builds exceeding these limits will be removed. If a tribe exceeds the limit, <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">the smallest bases will be removed first</>.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">ADDITIONAL RULES</>

• No building in <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">mission zones</>.
• Do not block the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Outpost Islands</> that spawn throughout the Ocean biome.
• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">One shipyard</> per tribe.
• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">One market</> per tribe.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">VIP MAP</>

These rules also apply to the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Genesis 1 VIP map</>.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">HOW TO CONNECT YOUR CHARACTER</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">WHY CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNT?</>

To get the most out of your time in Project Eden, link your accounts to our community website. This allows our systems to deliver <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Shop purchases</>, apply <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">playtime discounts</>, automatically assign <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Discord roles</>, and unlock full access to our community.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">HOW TO LINK:</>

1. Visit <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">https://arkprojecteden.com</> and sign in using a supported service such as <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Steam, Epic Games, Microsoft, Discord</> or <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Google</>.

2. Once you're in-game, type <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">!getconnectcode</> <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">twice</> in global or local chat. Copy the generated code and enter it on the website under <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Settings → Alternative Connect Methods</>.

Alternatively, you can use <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">/connect</> in the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">#bot-commands</> channel on Discord.

3. Make sure your <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Discord account</> is connected on the same page.

Once connected, our systems can recognise your character and provide the features associated with your account.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">IMPORTANT:</>

Register your <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">tribe on Discord</> as soon as possible! Our Admin Team uses the tribe registry during server clean-ups to identify active and inactive tribes. If your tribe is not registered and we have no way of confirming that it is still active, your structures and dinos may be removed.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">HOW DO I GET MY STARTER PACK?</>

Once your accounts are connected, open the in-game Shop through <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Radial Menu → GSA → Shop</> or press <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">F6</> on PC.
Your <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Starter Pack</> will be available to claim there.

Prefer using a browser? You can also access the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Shop</> directly through our community website.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">THE EDEN ECONOMY</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">EDEN TOKENS</>

Eden Tokens are the main currency used throughout the Eden Shop and on our servers.

They can be used as a <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">trading currency</> and are <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">transferable between players</>. <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Token Gems</> are the in-game version of Eden Tokens and are the primary currency used for player markets.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">WAYS TO EARN</>

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">NEW PLAYER BONUS</>

Connect your accounts and receive <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">100 Tokens</>.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">PLAYTIME REWARDS</>

Earn <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">1 Orange Token Gem</> for every hour of playtime.
Each Gem is worth <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">50 Tokens</> when consumed.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">VOTE REWARDS</>

Earn <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">50 Tokens per vote</>. You can vote once per day on each of the three supported maps.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">WEEKLY VOTE BONUS</>

Reach <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">15 votes within a week</> and receive an additional <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">200 Tokens</>.
The bonus resets every week.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">COMMUNITY EVENTS</>

Take part in our community events for a chance to earn <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">up to 10,000 Tokens</>.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">GENERAL RULES</>
content.text:
Help us keep Project Eden a friendly, fair and enjoyable community for everyone.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Respect Others</> — Hate speech, harassment and toxic behaviour are not permitted.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">No Cheating</> — Hacks, dupes, exploits or third-party tools that provide an unfair advantage will result in a ban.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">No Griefing</> — Do not intentionally interfere with another player's gameplay or progression.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">No Trolling</> — Do not deliberately provoke, obstruct or disrupt other Survivors.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Report Exploits</> — If you discover a bug or exploit, report it to the Admin Team instead of abusing it.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">No Player Trapping</> — Trapping other players is considered trolling and is not permitted.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Respect Breeding</> — Do not steal eggs or unclaimed babies belonging to other Survivors.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Contacting Admins</> — Please do not direct message Admins with questions that can be answered in general chat or through a support ticket.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">BUILDING & BREEDING</>
content.text:
Help keep the cluster smooth and enjoyable for everyone. Build, breed and decorate with the performance of the cluster in mind.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">BUILDING & BASES</>

1. There is no strict base size limit, but <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">don't go overboard</>. Use only the space you actually need and be prepared to downscale if requested by the Admin Team.

2. Where possible, build <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">outside the render distance of other tribes</>.

3. Collect your taming traps and remove temporary structures once they are no longer needed.

4. Do not build on <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">player spawn locations</>. Trapped players will be freed and offending structures may be removed.

5. Do not block mission terminals, obelisks, boss zones, explorer notes, major resource locations or important player access points.

6. Do not spam foundations or pillars simply to claim land.

7. Take down unused pens, starter huts and abandoned structures.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">BREEDING & TAMES</>

8. We strongly encourage the use of the <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Propagator</> for breeding. It helps reduce server load and eliminates the need for large outdoor breeding lines.

9. If you choose to breed manually without the Propagator, you may have a maximum of <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">40 breeding dinos</> out at one time.

10. Tames left breeding while you are offline may be <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">redgunned by Admins</> to reduce server load.

11. Use cryopods or dino balls to store excess creatures. If your base is causing excessive lag, Admins may ask you to cryo some tames. <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">You are expected to comply.</>

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">DECORATION & PERFORMANCE</>

12. Decor and building mods should be used with moderation.

13. Excessive decorations, structures and light sources can cause lag and crashes. <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Prioritise server performance</> over unnecessary decoration.

14. Excessive gates may be removed. Where possible, use Plant Species X, turrets and dino leashes instead of large walls and gate systems.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">TURRETS & RESOURCE NODES</>

15. Turrets used for base defence must be set to <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Wild Dinos Only</>.

16. <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Turret boxes at Wyvern trenches are not permitted</> and will be removed immediately.

17. Gas and Oil Pumps must remain <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">unlocked and available for public use</>.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">TRIBE RULES</>
content.text:
Tribe rules help us keep the cluster organised, fair and consistent across all maps.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">One Tribe Name</> — Your tribe must use the same name on every server across the cluster.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Character Names</> — Character names must not use <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">"Human"</> as a name.

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Base Limit</> — Each tribe may have <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">one main base per map</>, plus <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">one small outpost</> of no more than <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">4×4 foundations</>.

content.title: <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">ITEM & DINO REPLACEMENT</>
content.text:
We do not replace items or dinos lost through normal gameplay or player negligence.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">NOT COVERED</>

• Deaths, including <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">AFK, dehydration or starvation</>.
• Normal gameplay risks or player negligence.
• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Lost or despawned death bags</>.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">TECHNICAL ISSUES</>

We use <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Inventory Backup Saver</>, which may allow us to recover and replace items lost due to technical issues such as:

• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Bugged death bags</>.
• <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Server crashes or unexpected disconnects</>.
• Other <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">game bugs or glitches</> that result in item loss.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">IMPORTANT</>

Recovery is only possible when the necessary backup data is available and an Admin is available to assist.

If you believe you have lost items due to a technical issue, please open a <RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">support ticket</> and provide as much information as possible, including what was lost and what happened.

<RichColor Color="0.0824,0.6078,0.5137,1">Please do not open tickets for losses that fall under the normal gameplay exclusions above.</>
